category_title: Preschoolers exhibiting physical aggression such as hitting, pushing, and kicking peers
minimal_context: The student is playing in the park with friends in the sand area.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are playing in the park now. Go ahead and play in the sand with your friends.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Runs over to the sand area and pushes a friend out of the way)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No! (Hits the friend who tries to sit next to him)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Kicks the friend and starts throwing sand and stones at them)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We are playing in the park now. Go ahead and play in the sand with your friends.

STUDENT: (Runs over to the sand area and pushes a friend out of the way)

TUTOR: Let's try to play together.

STUDENT: No! (Hits the friend who tries to sit next to him)

TUTOR: What is happening over there?

STUDENT: (Kicks the friend and starts throwing sand and stones at them)

task.learning_goal: To make sure our friend is not hurt

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Threw sand and stone, running, pushing our friends, hitting, kicking
related_quotes: The teacher is angry because he threw sand and stone. The teacher said, “Go and sit on that red chair. We will go to the park and you will stay here and wait. Then the child started to sit and wait while his friends were in the park.”
…Not running, not pushing our friends, not hitting, not kicking, not throwing stones

behavior_patterns.condition: When interacting with peers in the park
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Throwing sand and stone, pushing, hitting, kicking
